in_sanskrit.name: रंगनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses all colours, supreme among colours

in_marathi.name: Ranganatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranganatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who holds the entire cosmos in his form, an aspect of Lord Vishnu

in_bengali.name: Ranganatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Cosmos
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ranganatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who holds the entire cosmos in his form, an aspect of Lord Vishnu
